caption:
Health insurance is getting pricier again. 🏥

KFF says benchmark ACA silver plan premiums will rise about 13% on average in 2027. That's the second year in a row of double-digit increases.

Since 2025, the total rise is about 42%.

Open enrollment runs through Jan. 15 in most states. Are you shopping around this year?
first_comment: Is your health plan going up this year? 👇
